newsitem.title: CANADA: Inmet CEO says bloodletting is over.
newsitem.headline: Inmet CEO says bloodletting is over.

text.p: The bloodletting at Inmet Mining Corp is over, chief executive Bill James said on Tuesday after the company reported major writedowns in its third quarter.
"We think we've pretty well wiped the slate clean here," James told a conference call with analysts. "We don't anticipate any more writedowns."

The copper, gold and zinc producer posted a third-quarter loss of C$361.8 million or C$4.46 a share after a writedown of C$355 million. For the same period last year, it earned C$18.8 million or C$0.22 a share.
